notes: Warrior survival builds now count what the Paladin side of the tree really does for you: War Scream's own 20% resistance (recast it every 30s), Emboldening Cry (+5% more and +8% damage), Counter and Riposte (always-on damage reduction), Second Chance (survive one fatal blow at 30% health), Rejuvenating Skin (part of the damage you take heals back) and Judgement's buff, so the search picks them when they help. Wynnbuilder's War Scream + Emboldening Cry party buttons now add up to 25% like on the site, and party damage buffs that don't stack in Wynnbuilder no longer stack here. Casting a spell twice in a row in rotations is ready but switched off until it's tested to never make a build worse.
